points.K16: 三级：按评估加呼吸防护
points.K18: 风险组3一定要进三级吗

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个大大的生物危害标志旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a large biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 今天讲风险分组和防护水平。

shots.scene: 四个彩色台阶和四扇门并排出现
shots.prompt_en: Four coloured steps appear beside four doors of increasing thickness. No people.
shots.narration: 病原有几组？实验室又分几级？

shots.scene: 阿杰对着电脑上的英文文献皱眉，屏幕空白只有数字图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a blank screen showing a number icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰读文献，看到一个风险组3。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 他想：三比一小，应该不太危险吧？

shots.scene: 小研举起一张阶梯卡，指着最高一级
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a step card and points at the top step.
shots.narration: 小研说：数字越大，其实越危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两块空白展板，一块画人群，一块画实验室
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two blank boards, one with people icons and one with a lab icon.
shots.narration: 一块讲病原分组，一块讲实验室分级。

shots.scene: 一个人形图标和下面一群人形图标
shots.prompt_en: One person icon above a small crowd of person icons. No people.
shots.narration: 分组看两点：对一个人伤害多大，

shots.scene: 人群图标之间出现扩散箭头
shots.prompt_en: Spreading arrows appear between the crowd icons. No people.
shots.narration: 还有会不会在人群里传开。

shots.scene: 四级台阶从低到高，标1到4
shots.prompt_en: Four steps rising from low to high, each with a dot count from one to four. No people.
shots.narration: 分成四组，数字越大越危险。

shots.scene: 一个绿色人形和一群绿色人形
shots.prompt_en: A green person icon above a green crowd. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组1：个人低风险，社区也低。

shots.scene: 绿色人形打个喷嚏，马上恢复笑脸
shots.prompt_en: A green person icon sneezes once and returns to a smile. No people.
shots.narration: 顶多轻微不适，不会致重病或死亡。

shots.scene: 黄色人形和一群绿色人形
shots.prompt_en: A yellow person icon above a green crowd. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组2：对个人有中等威胁，

shots.scene: 黄色人形旁一个药瓶图标，人群保持绿色
shots.prompt_en: A medicine bottle icon beside the yellow person; the crowd stays green. No people.
shots.narration: 一般有药可治，传给社区的风险低。

shots.scene: 红色人形和一群绿色人形
shots.prompt_en: A red person icon above a green crowd. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组3：可让个人患重病甚至死亡，

shots.scene: 红色人形旁有药瓶，人群仍是绿色
shots.prompt_en: A medicine bottle beside the red person; the crowd remains green. No people.
shots.narration: 但有治疗手段，社区传播风险低。

shots.scene: 红色人形和一群红色人形
shots.prompt_en: A red person icon above a red crowd. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组4：个人和社区风险都高。

shots.scene: 疫苗和药瓶图标上画问号
shots.prompt_en: Vaccine and medicine icons with question marks over them. No people.
shots.narration: 可能没有疫苗和药，后果严重。

shots.scene: 四扇门由薄到厚排开，门上依次一到四个点
shots.prompt_en: Four doors from thin to thick, marked with one to four dots. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室防护水平也分四级。

shots.scene: 老李摊开空白设计图，旁边放一本空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer spreads a blank floor plan next to a blank manual.
shots.narration: 设计实验室、写安全手册，都按级别来。

shots.scene: 一个方盒房间，箭头从门口流进去
shots.prompt_en: A box-shaped room with arrows flowing in through the doorway. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭实验室里，气压比外面低。

shots.scene: 门缝处的小纸条被吸向屋内
shots.prompt_en: A small paper strip at the door gap is drawn inward. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫负压，空气只往里流。

shots.scene: 屋顶排风口带过滤器图标，箭头向上
shots.prompt_en: A roof exhaust with a filter icon and arrows going up. No people.
shots.narration: 出去的空气，必须先经过高效过滤。

shots.scene: 小研站在气流箭头中，穿实验服戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands among airflow arrows, wearing a lab coat and gloves.
shots.narration: 气流能帮人，但不是万能的。

shots.scene: 实验服、手套、护目镜、口罩图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, gloves, goggles and a mask light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护照样要穿戴齐全。

shots.scene: 进风口过滤器，箭头穿过变成干净的蓝色
shots.prompt_en: Air passes through an inlet filter and turns clean blue. No people.
shots.narration: 空气经过滤进来，

shots.scene: 蓝色气流流过工作台上的样本架
shots.prompt_en: Blue airflow passes over a sample rack on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 流过操作区，带走可能的污染，

shots.scene: 排风过滤器后，城镇图标安然无恙
shots.prompt_en: After the exhaust filter, a small town icon stays safe. No people.
shots.narration: 再过滤才排出去，社区就安全。

shots.scene: 二级实验室俯视图，入口处一台高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a lab with an autoclave beside the entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 看二级实验室：入口处有灭菌器。

shots.scene: 门上贴生物危害标志，旁边一个按键锁
shots.prompt_en: A door with a biohazard warning sign and a keypad lock beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 门上有生物危害标识，

shots.scene: 阿杰在门边刷指纹，门禁亮绿灯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scans his fingerprint at the door reader; it lights green.
shots.narration: 还可装密码或指纹锁，防外人进入。

shots.scene: 俯视图远端：生物安全柜和通风柜并排
shots.prompt_en: Top view: a biosafety cabinet and a fume hood side by side at the far end of the room. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜和通风柜放在最里面。

shots.scene: 气流箭头从门口掠过地面和人员，流向远端柜子
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows sweep from the door across the floor and past a worker to the far cabinets.
shots.narration: 空气从门口流进，经过人，再进柜子。

shots.scene: 老李检查柜顶的硬管排风连接
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the hard-ducted exhaust connection on top of a cabinet.
shots.narration: 两者硬管连接，纳入建筑设计。

shots.scene: 三个带不同图标的废物桶：化学、生物、放射
shots.prompt_en: Three waste bins marked with chemical, biohazard and radiation pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 废物按化学、生物、放射分开收。

shots.scene: 整洁的实验台，台面空旷
shots.prompt_en: A tidy, clear laboratory bench. No people.
shots.narration: 还要有合适、好清洁的实验台。

shots.scene: 三级实验室门口，标识加身份识别器
shots.prompt_en: A higher-level lab door with a warning sign and an identity reader. No people.
shots.narration: 三级实验室：门禁更严格，

shots.scene: 两道门之间一个小前室，箭头表示压力平衡
shots.prompt_en: A small anteroom between two doors, with arrows showing pressure balancing. No people.
shots.narration: 进门先过前室，像个气闸。

shots.scene: 小研在前室里等外门关好，再推内门
shots.prompt_en: In the anteroom, the female graduate student waits for the outer door to close before pushing the inner door.
shots.narration: 压力平衡了，再进里面。

shots.scene: 三级俯视图，气流箭头一路向里
shots.prompt_en: Top view of the higher-level lab with arrows flowing inward throughout. No people.
shots.narration: 这里同样负压，气流一路向里。

shots.scene: 高压灭菌器从门口移到房间里面
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave icon slides from the entrance into the room. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌器搬进了实验室内部。

shots.scene: 远端柜子的排风经过滤器排到室外
shots.prompt_en: Exhaust from the far cabinets passes through filters to the outside. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子接好排风，排气全部过滤。

shots.section_title: 三级：按评估加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 小研穿戴防护服和呼吸防护面罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a protective gown and a respirator.
shots.narration: 三级里，防护还要加上呼吸防护。
overlay: 三级：按评估加呼吸防护

shots.section_title: 三级：按评估加呼吸防护
shots.scene: 评估表和防护用品图标用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form linked by an arrow to PPE icons. No people.
shots.narration: 具体穿什么，由风险评估决定。

shots.scene: 五个图标依次点亮：安全柜、通风柜、灭菌器、双门、气流
shots.prompt_en: Five icons light up: a biosafety cabinet, a fume hood, an autoclave, a double door and airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 三级要素：两种柜子、灭菌器，

shots.scene: 欣欣数着手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its paw.
shots.narration: 安全双门，再加定向气流。

shots.section_title: 风险组3一定要进三级吗
shots.scene: 欣欣举着问号牌，旁边是3组和三级门
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a question card beside a step icon and a thick door icon.
shots.narration: 常有人问：风险组3一定进三级吗？
overlay: 风险组3一定要进三级吗

shots.section_title: 风险组3一定要进三级吗
shots.scene: 讲台上的人形图标说出“看情况”，旁边是评估表
shots.prompt_en: A speaker icon beside a blank assessment form and a rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 讲者答：取决于管理控制。

shots.section_title: 风险组3一定要进三级吗
shots.scene: 空白评估表被逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form being ticked item by item. No people.
shots.narration: 每种情况，都要彻底做风险评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起生物危害标志，向镜头敬礼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a biohazard warning sign and salutes the camera.
shots.narration: 原片的结束语：时刻做好生物安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在台阶和门的图标中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the step icons and the door icons.
shots.narration: 分组看个人和社区两点风险。

shots.scene: 负压房间、过滤器、柜子、前室图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a negative-pressure room, filters, cabinets and an anteroom light up. No people.
shots.narration: 负压、过滤、柜子、前室，层层把关。

shots.scene: 问号牌和打勾的评估表图标
shots.prompt_en: A question card next to a ticked assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 用哪级实验室，取决于控制和评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student and the young male student at a lab door.
shots.narration: 分清级别，做好生物安全，再见！
